€6P. (ऋचति, आनर्च, आचींत्, अर्चितुम्) 
__1 To praise, extol, celebrate; याभ्यां गायत्रमृच्यते [[Rv. 8. 38. 10.]] 
__2 To cover, screen 
__3 To shine.

f. [ऋच्यते स्तूयतेऽनया, ऋच् करणे क्विप्] 
__1 A hymn (in general). 
__2 A single verse, stanza, or text; a verse of the Ṛgveda (opp. यजुस् and सामन्); त्रेधा बिहिता वागृचो यजूंषि सामानि [[Śat. Br.]] 
__3 The collective body of the Ṛgveda (pl.), ऋचः सामानि जज्ञिरे [[Rv. 10. 90. 9.]] ऋक्साम यजुरेब च [[Bg. 9. 17.]] 
__4 Splendour (for रुच्). 
__5 Praise. 
__6 worship. 
-Comp. 
-अयनम् [ऋचामयनम्] N. of a book; ऋक्पारायण, °आदि N. of a collection of words in Pāṇini. 
-आवानम् the time for reciting the Vedas. 
-गाथा N. of a certain song consisting of rik-like stanzas; ऋग्गाथा पाणिका दक्षबिहिता ब्रह्मगीतिका [[Y. 3. 114.]] 
-तन्त्रम्, [Page0488-1] 
-व्याकरणम् N. of the Pariśiṣtas of the Sāma Veda. 
-ब्राह्मणम् The Aitareya Brāhmaṇa. 
-भाज् a. partaking of a Ṛk. (as a deity who is addressed with it). 
-विधानम् the performance of certain rites, by reciting verses of the Ṛgveda. 
-वेदः the oldest of the four Vedas, and the most ancient sacred book of the Hindus. [The Ṛgveda is said to have been produced from fire; cf. [[Ms. 1. 23.]] This Veda is divided, according to one arrangement, into 8 Aṣṭakas, each of which is divided into as many Adhyāyas; according to another arrangement into 10 Maṇḍalas, which are again subdivided into 1000 Anuvākas, and comprises 1000 sūktas. The total number of verses or Ṛks is above 10000]. 
-संहिता the arranged collection of the hymns of Ṛgveda. 
-साम (°मे dual) the verses Ṛk and Sāman. °शृङ्गः N. of Viṣṇu.
